as the active endeavor]] Endeavors are a housing feature accessed through the Housing Dashboard. These neighborhood-wide activities are an opportunity to earn extra House XP and unique decor purchased with Community Coupons. During endeavors, specific groups from around Azeroth and beyond visit the neighborhoods, bringing unique NPCs, vendors, quests, and tasks. Each neighborhood can have one active endeavor, and each endeavor lasts for a little over a month. In private neighborhoods, a Neighborhood Manager must choose an endeavor by speaking to Lyssabel Dawnpetal or Tocho Cloudhide. In public neighborhoods, endeavors start automatically and are chosen by the game itself.

The Endeavor Coffer is a chest located next to the Founders Point Bulletin Board in Founder's Point and the Razorwind Shores Bulletin Board in Razorwind Shores. An Endeavor Coffer can only be opened when its respective neighborhood has completely filled the endeavor progress bar. A chat message notifies residents when coffer rewards are available: :
